stories.subject: Nivea / remission update after CML diagnosis
stories.headline: NIVEA REMISSION UPDATE
stories.deck: The singer said on Tamron Hall that her CML is in remission after treatment. She is still managing side effects while returning her focus to music and motherhood.
stories.verification: People reports the Oct. 7 Tamron Hall appearance and CML context; iHeart’s radio coverage independently reports the remission update and treatment background.

stories.subject: Prince Estate / Calabama Vault Raw EP
stories.headline: PRINCE GOES RAW
stories.deck: The four-track EP pairs an untouched “Vault Raw” take with the horn-enhanced Timeless mix and two Prince And The Band recordings. It answers fan pressure for transparency around posthumous changes.
stories.verification: NPG’s official Prince site and Shore Fire’s release announcement confirm the four-track EP; AllHipHop reports the fan criticism and the estate’s raw-version response.

stories.subject: K. Michelle / Jesus & Whiskey country-album weekend
stories.headline: K. MICHELLE GOES COUNTRY
stories.deck: Jesus & Whiskey lands Oct. 16 with a three-night New Orleans–Dallas–Houston run. The R&B veteran is bringing her Southern-soul catalog into a new country chapter.
stories.verification: BBR Music Group confirms the Oct. 16 album and three-city weekend; RTTNews independently reports the same release and live dates.

stories.subject: Offset and Don Toliver / Every Night single
stories.headline: OFFSET + DON FLIP JODECI
stories.deck: Offset and Don Toliver’s “Every Night” samples Jodeci’s “Freek’n You.” It previews Offset’s GMFU, due Oct. 23.
stories.verification: Universal Music Canada confirms the Jodeci sample, single and Oct. 23 album date; iHeart and Apple Music corroborate the release and project context.

stories.subject: GTA VI / optional Jason and Lucia relationship system
stories.headline: GTA VI ROMANCE OPTIONAL
stories.deck: Rockstar says Jason and Lucia can build their bond through shared activities, but players can skip the romance layer. The system changes how the duo feels without blocking the main crime story.
stories.verification: Rockstar Report summarizes Rob Nelson’s full IGN interview; GamesRadar independently reports the optional relationship detail, while Rockstar’s official page confirms the protagonists and Nov. 19 release date.

source_policy: Five distinct current hip-hop, R&B and GTA VI stories; each checked against at least two reputable or primary sources; topics excluded from the Oct. 11 morning and afternoon batches and prior automation memory.
